When a person prostrates at a verse of prostration, Satan withdraws weeping that man obeyed and earned Paradise while he refused and is doomed to Hell.
At the call to prayer and the Iqama Satan flees, breaking wind, then returns to distract the worshipper until he does not know how much he has prayed.
A wicked jinn, in another report Iblis with a flame of fire, tried to disrupt the Prophet's prayer; he would have bound him but for his brother Solomon's supplication.
Seen with a wife, once Safiyya visiting his i'tikaf, the Prophet told passers-by who she was, as Satan circulates in man like blood and might put evil in their hearts.
Satan despairs of being worshipped in Arabia but sows discord, prizing most whoever splits spouses; everyone has a devil, but Allah keeps the Prophet safe from his.
